body:
## Full-payment plots in Sector S

Our available Sector S plots are offered on full payment only; installments are not currently offered here. Confirm current available sizes, plot numbers and the total payable amount before deciding.

## Sector S plan and plot position

Use the official Sector S plan to understand road widths, plot dimensions and the exact position of an offered plot. Ask for the current plot number marked on the plan before you shortlist.

## Compare with other sectors

Sector S, Sector T and Model Blocks O, P, Q and R are offered on full payment. Compare exact plot sizes, locations and total payable amounts. Limited installment options may be available in K Block for 10 marla and above only, subject to confirmation on WhatsApp.

## Before you proceed

Confirm the exact plot, full-payment terms, dues, special-location charges, payment recipient and receipt process before making a material payment.

faqsText:
Is Sector S available on installments? | No. Our available Sector S plots are currently offered on full payment only.
Are 5 marla plots available on installments? | No. We are not currently offering 5 marla or 5.56 Marla plots on installments.
Are there any installment options? | Limited installment options may be available in K Block for 10 marla and above only, subject to confirmation on WhatsApp.
Is 5.56 Marla currently available in Sector S? | Not in the active inventory listed here. Ask for the latest available sizes.
Is there an official Sector S plan? | Yes. The official sector plan PDF is linked on this page. It shows layout, not live availability.
What should I confirm before payment? | Confirm the exact plot number, total payable amount, dues, location charges and payment instructions.
